newsitem.title: USA: Nabors Industries sees rig rates rising.
newsitem.headline: Nabors Industries sees rig rates rising.

text.p: Nabors Industries Inc said Wednesday its worldwide utilization is 65 percent, and it expects rig rates to continue rising as demand for certain rigs continues to out-pace supply.
But the company said rig level cash flows remain "well below" what is necessary to justify new construction.
Nabors said it owns more than 40 stacked premium SCR rigs that can be reactivated at much lower costs than new builds as market rates and conditions warrant.
The company reported earnings per share of $0.29 fully diluted compared with $0.20 fully diluted for the same period a year ago.

The company said its improvement reflects the satisfactory resolution of the "non-recurring operating problems" that affected its Saudi Arabian, Rocky Mountain footage and turnkey operations during the last several quarters.
